objective: Verify whether the product catalogue contains a Castrol Automotive Cleaner from the 'Castrol Workshop MAGNATEC 213-NWR Automotive Cleaner' line with cleaner type 'brake cleaner' and volumes 4000 ml and 250 ml, as claimed by a support note.

params.matching_variants: query product_variants where LOWER(brand) = LOWER(:brand) AND LOWER(product_name) LIKE LOWER('%' || :product_name_search || '%')
params.has_cleaner_type: check if any variant in $matching_variants has a property in product_variant_properties with key 'cleaner_type' and value_text = :cleaner_type
params.has_volume_4000: check if any variant in $matching_variants has a property with key 'volume' and value_number = :volume_4000 and also satisfies has_cleaner_type
params.has_volume_250: check if any variant in $matching_variants has a property with key 'volume' and value_number = :volume_250 and also satisfies has_cleaner_type
params.verified_sku: the variant(s) that satisfy both cleaner_type and volume conditions
